study type: Retrospective cohort study using a birth register
outcome: increased postpartum bleeding in vaginal delivery
higher placental to birth weight ratio (PBW ratio)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 36,083 women who gave birth at Kuopio University Hospital, Finland, between 2002 and 2016.
finding: The use of quetiapine or any antipsychotic during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of several adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes, including increased postpartum bleeding, prolonged neonatal hospitalization, higher placental to birth weight ratio, and gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: Quetiapine use and any antipsychotic use were both associated with a higher risk of increased postpartum bleeding in vaginal delivery.
